description: 高壓用電設備檢驗機構資訊 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部能源署. 依據「經濟部認可檢驗機構與原製造廠家及高壓用電設備施行試驗作業要點」規定，檢驗機構係指依經濟部認可之高壓用電設備項目及試驗類型施行試驗之機構。 經濟部能源署已建置高壓用電設備試驗與審查資訊系統( highvoltage. org. tw)，登錄高壓用電設備檢驗機構資訊，可供廠家查詢及選擇送交何間檢驗機構施作試驗。 本... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部能源署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
